assumptions: germline: IMGT/GENE-DB V and J alleles as ANARCI ships them, aligned to the 128 IMGT states.

repertoire: OAS unpaired · Jaffe_2022 (doi:10.1038/s41586-022-05371-z) · human · PBMC · naive B cells · disease None · vaccine None · every unit the search returned (47 heavy, 10 light), numbered by OAS with ANARCI under IMGT, counted once per unique sequence (retrieved 2026-10-21).
Each residue is read at its own IMGT state; an insertion (111A) has no column in either table and gets no frequency.
limits: A germline distribution is not a repertoire: somatic mutation and selection are not counted, so a residue rare in germlines can be common in expressed antibodies.
The repertoire is one named OAS subset (human naive B cells from healthy donors), not all of OAS: naive repertoires carry little somatic mutation, and other species or T-cell receptors are refused.
abYsis's 1% cut was defined on a repertoire; on the germline distribution it is applied to alleles.
bio.jane/contract.question: Which residues of this variable domain are unusual at their IMGT position, measured against the species' germline alleles or an expressed repertoire?

description: How common each residue of an antibody variable domain is at its IMGT position, and which residues are rarer there than a cut (abYsis's 1% "unusual residue" by default). Two distributions: IMGT's own germline V and J alleles of a species (one count per reference allele), or a bundled Observed Antibody Space repertoire subset (one count per unique expressed sequence; human naive B cells, Jaffe et al. 2022). Graded against independent pandas counts of ANARCI's germline alignments and of every OAS data unit of the subset.

_files.description: The project: record references shaped like _subject. Their records become library documents a tool names in sequences/parts/document; a trace or alignment is found by file name.

_subject.description: The record to act on: exactly one of sequence, accession (+source), sample (an id from list_samples) or file ({name, text} or {name, base64}); record_index picks one record of several.

distribution.description: what each position is counted over: `germline` (IMGT's V and J alleles of `germline_species`) or `repertoire` (the bundled human OAS subset of expressed sequences).

germline_species.description: the species whose IMGT germline alleles each position is counted over (germline distribution only; the repertoire is human).

protein.description: the protein sequence (one-letter amino acids); every antibody and T-cell-receptor variable domain in it is read.

rare_below.description: a residue is rare where its share of the alleles or sequences is below this fraction (abYsis's unusual-residue cut is 0.01).

species.description: species whose HMMs are preferred when numbering (ANARCI's default: human and mouse).

name: antibody_position_frequencies

domains.description: per domain: chain type, span, what the table counted (germline allele counts, or the repertoire's sequence count and subset), and per residue its IMGT position, 0-based sequence index, count, denominator, frequency, the commonest residue there and whether it is rare

rare.description: one `IMGT position residue (count of n)` string per rare residue, in sequence order
